Neither document publishes external dimensions or the cryocooler type; the brochure calls the series 'a range of closed cycle cryostats'. The cryogen enum value cryogen_free_pulse_tube is the closest enum for a cryogen-free closed-cycle He-3 sorption system but the pulse-tube/GM choice is NOT documented for this model (listed in not_found). Both wiring entries describe the same single 24-way Fischer loom from two sources; render one 24-wire loom. Windows and magnets are optional and NOT fitted in this configuration.
